name: claude-policy-python311
layout: <env dir>/bin/python3.11 links to the uv-managed CPython under $AGENTSWE_HOME/python
used_as: the host interpreter of the evaluator's Candidate syntax check (agentloop/evaluator/materialize.py syntax_runtime: python -m py_compile of the plugin hook and inspector; the hook itself runs in the edit-candidate-python311 image)
notes: The paper evaluator took python3.11 or python3.12 from PATH, else another task environment's python3.11 that happened to be on the paper hosts, else its own interpreter. A release install has neither the second nor, on most hosts, the first, and the control plane's /usr/bin/python3 may be older than 3.11 (BuildInfrastructureError 'evaluator lacks the task-required Python 3.11+ stdlib runtime' on every submission), so the task ships this pinned interpreter and materialize.py lists it after the PATH lookups.
